items.title: Griffin Gaming Partners, Entertainment 360 jointly unveil production company Hitpoint Entertainment
items.en_title: Griffin Gaming Partners, Entertainment 360 jointly unveil production company Hitpoint Entertainment
items.en_oneliner: Game investment fund Griffin Gaming Partners and Hollywood agency Entertainment 360 jointly formed a production company focused on game-to-film adaptations.

items.title: Griffin Gaming Partners and Entertainment 360 launch new company to support video game adaptations for film and TV
items.en_title: Griffin Gaming Partners and Entertainment 360 launch new company to support video game adaptations for film and TV
items.en_oneliner: Griffin Gaming Partners and Entertainment 360 formed a new company dedicated to supporting game adaptations for film and TV, another route for game IP going global.

items.title: "Players want to engage with brands, not just consume them" – Mattel on its new Game Studios arm, why it's releasing on Roblox, and what it learnt from NetEase
items.en_title: "Players want to engage with brands, not just consume them" – Mattel on its new Game Studios arm, why it's releasing on Roblox, and what it learnt from NetEase
items.en_oneliner: Mattel discusses its newly formed Game Studios division, explaining why it chose Roblox as its launch platform and what it learned from working with NetEase.

items.title: Japan Actors Union announces guidelines addressing unauthorised use of generative AI to replicate voice performances
items.en_title: Japan Actors Union announces guidelines addressing unauthorised use of generative AI to replicate voice performances
items.en_oneliner: Japan's actors union issued guidelines restricting generative AI from replicating voice acting without authorization, giving voice actors new grounds for defending their rights.

items.title: Sensor Tower data shows the yawning gap between GTA 6 and everything else
items.en_title: Sensor Tower data shows the yawning gap between GTA 6 and everything else
items.en_oneliner: Sensor Tower data shows GTA 6 pre-orders far exceed other AAA titles in recent years, with the market appeal gap for top products astonishing.

items.title: GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 moves to four-day format to "create a higher quality, more focused and valuable experience"
items.en_title: GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 moves to four-day format to "create a higher quality, more focused and valuable experience"
items.en_oneliner: GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 moves to a four-day format, held March 1 to 4, with organizers saying they want a higher-quality, more focused experience.

items.title: Accessibility basics: How to make your game more accessible
items.en_title: Accessibility basics: How to make your game more accessible
items.en_oneliner: Unity explains the basics of game accessibility design, giving simple workable starting points across hearing, vision, controls, and cognitive needs, with the earlier you start the easier it is.

items.title: RocketWerkz' C# framework 'BRUTAL' is now available to all developers
items.en_title: RocketWerkz' C# framework 'BRUTAL' is now available to all developers
items.en_oneliner: RocketWerkz's C# framework BRUTAL is now available to all developers, suited to teams wanting full control over their game code.

items.title: PEGI begins moving existing digital-only games with loot boxes up to a 16 rating
items.en_title: PEGI begins moving existing digital-only games with loot boxes up to a 16 rating
items.en_oneliner: PEGI began raising existing digital-only games with loot boxes to a 16+ rating, with previous lower age ratings no longer applying.

items.title: Moonlighter developer delays public playtest of next game over concerns of AI cloning
items.en_title: Moonlighter developer delays public playtest of next game over concerns of AI cloning
items.en_oneliner: The Moonlighter developer delayed a public playtest of its next game over generative AI cloning concerns, testing only in a small Discord community, a testing strategy worth borrowing in the AI era.

items.title: Wizards of the Coast declines to voluntarily recognize D&D and Studio X union drive
items.en_title: Wizards of the Coast declines to voluntarily recognize D&D and Studio X union drive
items.en_oneliner: Wizards of the Coast declined to voluntarily recognize the union drive by D&D and Studio X teams, and employees will decide via secret ballot whether to join a union.
